summary.text: Chris Worrell is a Democratic state representative who has represented the Massachusetts House of Representatives 5th Suffolk District since January 4, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Before the House he worked as a radio personality, in diversity and inclusion at the Boston Planning & Development Agency, and as director of constituent services for the Massachusetts State Senate.

paragraphs.text: Christopher Worrell graduated from Lincoln Sudbury Regional High School in 2004 and earned an associate degree from Bunker Hill Community College in 2006.

His career experience includes working as a radio personality with Big City 101.3 FM, as an assistant director of diversity, equity, and inclusion at the Boston Planning & Development Agency, and as director of constituent services of the Massachusetts State Senate.

Worrell succeeded Liz Miranda in the 5th Suffolk District seat and, according to Ballotpedia, was assigned in 2025-2026 to the Steering, Policy and Scheduling Committee and the Education, Financial Services, and Public Safety and Homeland Security joint committees, serving as vice chair of the last.
